# Third-party code

`vaft.user.js` is from [TwitchAdSolutions](https://github.com/pixeltris/TwitchAdSolutions)
(MIT license, see `TwitchAdSolutions-LICENSE.txt`), copied unchanged from the repo's final
commit (version 37.0.0, March 2026). The repo is archived, so it won't get fixes when Twitch
changes things.

SaltyTV only loads it when you turn on **Try to skip Twitch ads** in the SaltyTV window. It runs
inside the Twitch player in the stream window and only talks to Twitch's own servers.
